title: Quickstart Spotlight Cards — throughput hints and quant profiles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a set of onboarding visual assets and in-console screenshot variants that introduce the Optimize toolkit's runtime recommendations: throughput hints (batching, concurrency), cache warmup behavior, and quantization profiles. Deliverables: a) three spotlight cards for the quickstart flow (card copy + art direction), b) two detailed modal walkthroughs showing "what happens" when users enable each recommendation, c) three annotated console screenshots (desktop + responsive crop) for docs and marketing. Focus: make guidance actionable, confidence-building, and scannable for engineers evaluating trade-offs between latency and cost.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct spotlight card mockups (Figma frames) with final copy and 2 density variants (compact and spacious)
Modal walkthrough designs for 'Throughput Hints' and 'Quant Profiles' showing before/after token cost and latency examples
Annotated console screenshots exported in PNG and SVG at 1x/2x across three breakpoints
Copy reviewed and approved by PM and Engineering (link to approvals in updates)
Exported assets uploaded to Design Drive folder and referenced in docs PR
updates: 2025-01-28: Ticket created. Kickoff sync with PM + Eng. Agreed scope: spotlight cards + 2 modals + 3 screenshots.

2025-02-03: First pass: wireframes for cards and modal flows uploaded to Figma. Feedback from Eng: include concrete numeric examples for latency/cost trade-offs and an option to preview sampled outputs when quantization is applied.

2025-02-05: Copy iteration 2 added to Figma. Design trade-off: simplified illustrations vs. real console screenshots — decided to use a hybrid approach (illustrated cards for marketing, real annotated screenshots for docs).

2025-02-08: Engineering provided sample telemetry numbers (p50, p95, token cost delta) for three scenarios. Reworked modal to display these metrics side-by-side. Added a small 'how we measure' tooltip for transparency.

2025-02-10: Internal review with Docs and Product. Docs requested microcopy changes for accessibility and an explicit 'rollback' microflow in the modal for canary rollouts. Added accessible color contrast checks.
2025-02-12: Assets exported and uploaded. Created PR in docs repo to swap placeholder images (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421). Requesting Design review and final PM sign-off.
decisions: Use illustrated spotlight cards with simple metaphors for quick comprehension; use real console screenshots for deep-dive docs to surface accurate UI affordances.
Display numeric examples (latency, cost delta) for three workload archetypes (chat, summarization, embeddings) to help engineers map to their workloads.
Modal will include a 'simulate' toggle that overlays expected token-level changes; implementation note: simulation not shipped in v1, the toggle links to a calculator page in docs.
Keep default card tone neutral/informative; call-to-action: 'Try Optimize with sample config' linking to quickstart template.
